primary_hypothesis: With the same hybrid delta+attention topology and training data, bidirectional attention inside the fully observed prompt (while keeping answer generation causal) improves generated reasoning versus fully causal prompt processing.
selection: fixed final step800 only; no held checkpoint selection
tokenizer: lossless UTF-8 byte vocabulary259; absolute G3 accuracy diagnostic only
completion: integer bytes + EOS only; shared across both arms
architecture: 2 gated-delta + 2 attention blocks; only prompt-attention visibility differs
delta_kernel: mathematically identical sequential recurrent implementation substituted for triangular-solve implementation after timing probe; no held results had been computed
reason_for_compute_amendment: batch32 triangular-solve path was resource-prohibitive; incomplete approximately200-step attempt is excluded. Timing-only probes led to batch16/800 before completed training or held evaluation.
no_oracle: generation sees prompt only; gold/case never enters model call
scope: 469648-parameter mechanism probe, not 300-800M result and not Qwen parity
